title: Welcome and how to use this handbook

passages.text: This handbook sets out Meridian Logistics' policies for employees in the United States. Where a state or local law gives you more than a policy here, the law governs.
Each section names its owner. Ask People Operations about any policy; your manager can explain how it applies to your team.
Policies change. The edition in force is the one with the latest effective date; earlier editions are kept for reference and say when they ended.
Meridian repays reasonable business expenses you pay yourself, with a receipt for anything over $40.
Meals while travelling are repaid up to a daily allowance of $68, or $23 for a single meal on a day trip.
Driving your own car on company business is repaid at 61 cents a mile; commuting is not.
Claim expenses within 45 days. Claims older than 90 days are not repaid.
Book travel through the company travel desk. Flights are economy, except flights over 9 hours, which may be premium economy.
Hotels are repaid up to $219 a night, or $289 a night in New York, San Francisco and Boston.
Travel over a weekend for business earns one day off in lieu, to be taken within 30 days.
Eligibility. You may make your own contributions from your first paycheck. The company match begins on your 90th day of employment, counting your first day as day 1.

Your contributions. You may contribute from 1% to 75% of your pay, up to the IRS limit on elective deferrals, which for 2026 is $24,500 (IRS Notice 2025-67). Change your rate at any time in the benefits portal.
Company match. Meridian matches 100% of the first 3% of pay you contribute, and 50% of the next 3%. Contributions above 6% of pay are not matched, so the most Meridian matches is 4.5% of your pay.
Match cap. The company match is capped at $6,300 a plan year, whatever your pay.
Vesting. Your own contributions are always 100% yours. The company match vests 25% for each full year of service: 25% after one year, 50% after two, 75% after three and 100% after four.
What changed. This summary replaces the 2024 edition from 1 January 2026. The match formula, the match cap, the waiting period and the vesting schedule all changed.
Eligibility. You may make your own contributions from your first paycheck. The company match begins after 60 days of employment.
Your contributions. You may contribute from 1% to 75% of your pay, up to the IRS limit on elective deferrals, which for 2024 is $23,000.
Company match. Meridian matches 50% of the first 10% of pay you contribute. Contributions above 10% of pay are not matched, so the most Meridian matches is 5% of your pay.
Match cap. There is no cap on the company match beyond the formula.
Vesting. Your own contributions are always 100% yours. The company match vests all at once after three full years of service; before then none of it is yours.
This edition was replaced by the restated summary of 1 January 2026.
Accrual. You earn 15 days of paid time off a year, or 20 days with 5 or more full years of service, accrued each pay period.
Carryover. Up to 7 unused days carry into the next year; with 5 or more full years of service, up to 10. Days above the limit are forfeited on 31 December, except where state law requires otherwise.
Using carried days. Days carried into a year must be used by 31 March of that year, or they are forfeited.
Leaving. Unused days of the current year are paid out when you leave; carried days are not, except where state law requires it.
Eligibility. Any parent, by birth, adoption or foster placement, is eligible who has worked for Meridian at least 180 days on the day the leave starts.
Pay. Parental leave is 11 weeks at full pay, followed by up to 4 more weeks at 60% of pay.
Timing. Leave must start within 12 months of the birth or placement, and may be taken in up to two blocks.
Notice. Tell your manager and People Operations at least 30 days before the leave starts, where you can.
Eligibility. Employees with at least one full year of service may claim for a course their manager agrees is related to their job.
Amount. Meridian repays 80% of tuition, up to $4,750 a calendar year. Books and fees are not repaid.
Grades. A course must be passed with a C or better, or a pass in a pass-fail course.
Repayment. If you leave Meridian within 12 months of a repayment, you repay it in full.
General. Dress for the work you do that day and for safety. Clothing with offensive words or images is not allowed anywhere.

Denver distribution centre. On the warehouse floor, steel-toe boots (ASTM F2413) are required and open-toe shoes are not allowed; in the yard, a Class 2 high-visibility vest. Jeans are fine Monday to Friday in the office too. Meridian pays a safety boot allowance of $150 a year to Denver warehouse staff.
Columbus office. Business casual Monday to Thursday; jeans on Fridays. Visitor days are business dress.
Memphis hub. Company-issued shirts on shift; steel-toe boots on the dock. Meridian provides two shirts a year and replaces worn ones.
Office staff with at least 6 months of service may work from home up to 2 days a week, with their manager's agreement.
Meridian pays a home internet stipend of $40 a month to those who work from home at least one day a week.
Warehouse, dock and yard roles cannot be done remotely.
Company laptops and phones are for work. Report a lost device to the service desk within 24 hours.
Passwords are never shared, and multi-factor sign-in is required for every company system.
Return all equipment on your last day; equipment not returned within 14 days is charged at its replacement cost.
Meridian observes 9 fixed holidays a year, listed in the benefits portal, and gives 2 floating holidays.
Floating holidays do not carry over and are not paid out when you leave.
Staff who work on a fixed holiday are paid at one and a half times their rate and get another day off within 60 days.
Non-exempt staff are paid overtime at one and a half times their rate for hours over 40 in a week, and as state law requires.
On-call staff are paid a stipend of $35 for each day on call, plus their rate for hours worked when called in.
No one is scheduled for more than 12 hours in a shift or less than 10 hours between shifts.
